d: There is a high-stakes financial race unfolding across Europe right now, not over who grows the fastest, but over which major economy is heading straight toward a sovereign debt crisis. When people hear "European debt crisis," they immediately think of Greece or Italy. Yet official Eurostat data reveals a dramatic reversal: Southern European nations are actively slashing their debt ratios, while Western and Northern European heavyweights, led by France, Belgium, and Finland are seeing their debt spiral upward at an alarming pace.
